interface.description: The wireless network interface to be used for sending frames (e.g., monitor mode interface).

mode.description: The test mode to execute. Valid options: b (Beacon Flood), a (Auth DoS), p (Probe/Bruteforce), d (Deauth), m (Michael), x (802.1X), w (WIDS), f (MAC Filter), g (WPA Downgrade).

target_ssid.description: The SSID to target or spoof. Used in modes b, p, x. Can also be a filename for mode b.

target_bssid.description: The MAC address (BSSID) of the target AP. Used in modes a, p, m, x, w, g.

target_channel.description: The channel to target or spoof on. Used in mode b. In mode d, can be a comma-separated list for channel hopping.

speed_pps.description: Packets per second limit. Can be a number or 'unlimited'. Varies by mode (e.g., default 50 for b, 400 for m/x).

extra_flags.description: Additional command-line flags specific to the chosen mode (e.g., -v for fakeap list, -j for TKIP QoS-Exploit). Items are strings representing the flag argument.
